desc: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features in affected log4j-core releases can allow attacker-controlled LDAP or other JNDI endpoints to lead to arbitrary code execution.
The incomplete fix for CVE-2021-44228 in Log4j 2.15.0 can permit information leakage or code execution in certain non-default configurations.
Spring MVC or WebFlux applications running on JDK 9+ can be vulnerable to remote code execution through data binding under affected deployment conditions.
MOVEit Transfer before the fixed releases has a SQL injection vulnerability that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to access or modify database contents.
PAN-OS GlobalProtect has a command injection vulnerability that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on affected firewalls.
zlib through 1.2.12 has a heap-based buffer over-read or buffer overflow in inflate via a large gzip header extra field; affected applications call inflateGetHeader.
Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 has an insufficient fix for path traversal that can expose files and, with CGI enabled, permit remote code execution.
Malicious code in upstream xz 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 source tarballs modifies liblzma during build and can affect software linked against the library.
A heap buffer overflow in libwebp can allow a remote attacker to perform an out-of-bounds memory write via a crafted HTML page.
A race condition in OpenSSH sshd can be triggered by an unauthenticated remote attacker who fails to authenticate within a set time period.
Insufficient data validation in Chrome DevTools can allow a remote attacker to bypass content security policy using a crafted HTML page.
